newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pan-United buys sixth container vessel.
newsitem.headline: Pan-United buys sixth container vessel.

text.p: Pan-United Corp said on Wednesday it had bought a 16,000 deadweight long ton (dwt) container vessel, the Nantai Princess, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Casprica Pte Ltd.
The company said in a statement it has set a medium term target of expanding its fleet by two ocean-going vessels per year given the increased demand for regional shipping vessels.
The 886-TEU vessel had been deployed on long-term charter, trading between the Far East and South Africa.
With the acquisition, the total carrying capacity of Pan-United's fleet is 146,000 dwt, it said.
Pan-United did not disclose the identity of the seller or the purchase price of the vessel.
